title: Check if Numbers Are Ascending in a Sentence
description:
A sentence is a list of tokens separated by a single space with no leading or trailing spaces. Every token is either a positive number or a word of lowercase letters. Return true if all numbers are strictly increasing.

Input Format:
A sentence string

Output Format:
true or false

testcases.input: 1 box has 3 blue 4 red 6 green and 12 yellow marbles
sunset is at 7 51 pm tonight overnight low will be 50 and 88 tomorrow
